completion_update.terminal_timestamp: The exact timestamp whose occurs_at equals interaction_ends_at remains claimable once while the service is unclosed. Ordinary post-end timestamps remain rejected. The automatic timestamp root may open only for that exact persisted terminal timestamp version.
completion_update.scheduler_root_contract: TimestampRootPreparer now enqueues every I04-composed outbox row in the claimed UnitOfWork and returns only a count; the scheduler no longer forces a rich flow to one synthetic text delivery.
